mapper.sql: tc.id, tc.teacher_id, tc.class_id, tc.subject_id, s.name as subject, c.class_name, tc.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM teacher_class tc LEFT JOIN class_info c ON tc.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN subject s ON tc.subject_id = s.id WHERE tc.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY tc.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM teacher_class tc LEFT JOIN class_info c ON tc.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN subject s ON tc.subject_id = s.id WHERE tc.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY tc.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM teacher_class tc LEFT JOIN class_info c ON tc.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN subject s ON tc.subject_id = s.id WHERE tc.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND tc.class_id = #{classId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_class (teacher_id, class_id, subject_id, subject) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{classId}, #{subjectId}, #{subject})
